dev.note: Listens on --port ${PORT:-3000}. PORT must be in the process env; it is not read from .env.

seed:client-site.note: Upserts the tenant by slug and replaces its content; never touches users. Exits after its revalidate pings finish.

seed:client.note: Upsert by e-mail; an existing password is kept unless CLIENT_RESET_PASSWORD=1.

seed:site-key.file: SITE_KEY_OUT (absolute, or relative to the backend dir): the key only, no name and no trailing newline; mode 0600, written atomically
seed:site-key.note: Replaces the tenant's site+<slug> account, so the previous key stops working. Exit 1 without touching the existing key if nothing answers at CMS_PROBE_URL; exit 1 without writing if the new key does not authenticate there.
